msg: Hola, buenos días. Deca del centro de buceo. Me recomendaron a ustedes para bucear en Cartagena. Yo voy a estar entre el 5 y el 7 por allá. Entonces quería ver si tienen alguna salida programada. Yo soy open y me gustaría salir un día y tal. No sé qué tienen. Muchas gracias.
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. ¡Qué alegría tenerte por acá! Con muchísimo gusto te ayudo a armar tu plan. 🌊

🌊 *Buceamos en las Islas del Rosario* (Parque Nacional Corales del Rosario), a 45–60 min en lancha desde Cartagena: aguas cálidas, arrecifes y mucha vida marina. Te resumo las opciones:

🆕 *¿Nunca has buceado?* → el *Minicurso de buceo* (bautismo): teoría, práctica en piscina y una inmersión en el mar con instructor. Desde los 10 años.

🤿 *¿Ya eres buzo certificado?* → *paquetes de inmersiones*: 2 buceos en 1 día, o planes multi-día (4, 5, 7 o 9 buceos).

🎓 *¿Quieres sacarte el título?* → *cursos PADI*: Open Water (el básico), Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades.

🐠 Y si prefieres sin bucear, el *snorkel* es una chulada para ver el arrecife desde la superficie.

¿Cuál te llama? Si quieres te armo la reserva. 😄

Si tu pregunta era sobre algo más concreto que esto, cuéntamelo con más detalle y te confirmo con exactitud. 🙂

¿Y para cuántas personas armamos el plan? Así te paso el precio exacto. 😊

msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Hi! Great plan to complete your Open Water with a refresher first — that will help you feel confident and ready.

For the Open Water Referral Course from Cartagena (2 days), the price per person is 474 USD online or 526 USD regular. It includes 4 certification dives with an instructor, boat transport, lunch on day 1, equipment, dive insurance, and the national park fee.

The Dive Mini Course (refresher) the day before, also from Cartagena, costs 183 USD online or 204 USD regular per person. It includes theory review, pool practice, 1 open-water dive, equipment, lunch, and dive insurance.

Since you have 2 persons, these prices apply per person. Would you prefer to stay overnight on the islands for the referral course or return to Cartagena each day? Also, which hotel are you staying at, to check if boat pick-up is available for the mini course?

I can help you with the next steps!

Where would you be departing from? We can pick you up *from Cartagena* or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?

Perfect! Staying on Isla Grande is super convenient for diving with us. Our dive base is right at two hotels there: Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso. If you stay at either, pick-up is direct from your hotel, making your diving days easy and smooth.

Other nearby hotels with boat access where we can pick you up are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao.

Accommodation isn’t included in our plans, so you book directly with the hotel. Would you like me to share more details about any of these hotels?

Where would you be departing from? We can pick you up *from Cartagena* or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.
